```{r}
#| label: matching-and-models
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(tidyverse)
library(MatchIt)
library(broom)
library(lmtest)
library(sandwich)
library(purrr)
library(here)

panel_base <- readRDS(here("data", "processed", "01_panel_base_9s.rds"))

run_strata_experiment <- function(min_sm, max_sm, target_gender, strata_name, data) {
  
  df_filtered <- data %>% filter(RENDA_SM >= min_sm & RENDA_SM < max_sm)
  
  # Dynamic Formulas based on Gender Stratification
  if (target_gender != "All") {
    df_filtered <- df_filtered %>% filter(sexo_harm == target_gender)
    form_match <- Treated ~ educ_harm + activity_harm + has_car + age_group + RENDA_SM
    form_exact <- ~ Year
    form_did_ext <- Y_Binary ~ Treated * Year_Factor + educ_harm + activity_harm + has_car + age_group
    form_did_int <- TOT_VIAG ~ Treated * Year_Factor + educ_harm + activity_harm + has_car + age_group
  } else {
    form_match <- Treated ~ educ_harm + activity_harm + has_car + age_group + RENDA_SM
    form_exact <- ~ Year + sexo_harm
    form_did_ext <- Y_Binary ~ Treated * Year_Factor + sexo_harm + educ_harm + activity_harm + has_car + age_group
    form_did_int <- TOT_VIAG ~ Treated * Year_Factor + sexo_harm + educ_harm + activity_harm + has_car + age_group
  }
  
  # Internal Helper to run matching and DiD for a given distance method
  run_match_method <- function(dist_method, dist_label) {
    match_obj <- matchit(
      formula = form_match,
      data = df_filtered, method = "nearest", distance = dist_method,
      exact = form_exact, ratio = 1, replace = FALSE 
    )
    
    matched_data <- match.data(match_obj) %>% mutate(Strata = strata_name, Match_Type = dist_label)
    
    did_df <- matched_data %>%
      mutate(Y_Binary = ifelse(TOT_VIAG > 0, 1, 0), Year_Factor = relevel(factor(Year), ref = "2017"))
    
    # FIX FOR SCOPING: Update formula environments to the current local environment
    # so vcovCL() can find 'did_df' when it re-evaluates the model.
    environment(form_did_ext) <- environment()
    environment(form_did_int) <- environment()
    
    # Extensive Margin
    model_ext <- lm(form_did_ext, data = did_df, weights = FE_PESS)
    res_ext <- tidy(coeftest(model_ext, vcov = vcovCL(model_ext, cluster = ~ZONA_07))) %>% filter(grepl("Treated:Year_Factor2023", term))
    
    # Intensive Margin
    model_int <- lm(form_did_int, data = did_df, weights = FE_PESS)
    res_int <- tidy(coeftest(model_int, vcov = vcovCL(model_int, cluster = ~ZONA_07))) %>% filter(grepl("Treated:Year_Factor2023", term))
    
    n_pre <- df_filtered %>% group_by(Year, Treated) %>% summarise(N_Pre = n(), .groups = "drop")
    n_post <- matched_data %>% group_by(Year, Treated) %>% summarise(N_Post = n(), .groups = "drop")
    
    sample_table <- n_pre %>%
      left_join(n_post, by = c("Year", "Treated")) %>%
      mutate(Grupo = ifelse(Treated == 1, "Tratado", "Controle")) %>% select(-Treated) %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = Grupo, values_from = c(N_Pre, N_Post), values_fill = 0) %>%
      mutate(
        Strata = strata_name,
        Match_Type = dist_label,
        DiD_Ext_Estimate = round(res_ext$estimate, 4), 
        DiD_Ext_SE = round(res_ext$std.error, 4),      # NEW: Extract Standard Error
        DiD_Ext_PValue = round(res_ext$p.value, 4),
        DiD_Int_Estimate = round(res_int$estimate, 4), 
        DiD_Int_SE = round(res_int$std.error, 4),      # NEW: Extract Standard Error
        DiD_Int_PValue = round(res_int$p.value, 4)
      ) %>%
      select(Strata, Match_Type, Year, N_Pre_Controle, N_Pre_Tratado, N_Post_Controle, N_Post_Tratado, 
             DiD_Ext_Estimate, DiD_Ext_SE, DiD_Ext_PValue, 
             DiD_Int_Estimate, DiD_Int_SE, DiD_Int_PValue)
    
    # RESTORED MISSING RETURN AND CLOSING BRACKET HERE
    return(list(sample_table = sample_table, matched_data = matched_data, match_obj = match_obj))
  }
  
  # Execute both methods
  res_mah <- run_match_method("mahalanobis", "Mahalanobis")
  res_log <- run_match_method("glm", "Logit")
  
  return(list(mah = res_mah, log = res_log))
}

# The 9 New Strata Definitions (plus the global baseline)
strata_defs <- list(
  list(0, Inf, "All", "Full Panel (Global)"),
  list(0, 0.77, "All", "S1_All"),
  list(0.77, 2.01, "All", "S2_All"),
  list(2.01, Inf, "All", "S3_All"),
  list(0, 0.77, "Male", "S1_Male"),
  list(0, 0.77, "Female", "S1_Female"),
  list(0.77, 2.01, "Male", "S2_Male"),
  list(0.77, 2.01, "Female", "S2_Female"),
  list(2.01, Inf, "Male", "S3_Male"),
  list(2.01, Inf, "Female", "S3_Female")
)

experiments <- map(strata_defs, ~run_strata_experiment(.x[[1]], .x[[2]], .x[[3]], .x[[4]], panel_base))
names(experiments) <- c("Full", "S1_All", "S2_All", "S3_All", "S1_Male", "S1_Female", "S2_Male", "S2_Female", "S3_Male", "S3_Female")

# Extract and combine tables for BOTH methods
master_sample_table <- map_dfr(experiments, ~ bind_rows(.x$mah$sample_table, .x$log$sample_table))

# For Triple Difference (DDD), run two separate models to prevent duplicating records.
master_matched_mah <- map_dfr(experiments[-1], ~ .x$mah$matched_data) %>% mutate(Year_Factor = relevel(factor(Year), ref = "2017"))
master_matched_log <- map_dfr(experiments[-1], ~ .x$log$matched_data) %>% mutate(Year_Factor = relevel(factor(Year), ref = "2017"))

# Triple Difference (DDD) - Intensive Margin
# Mahalanobis
mod_ddd_int_mah <- lm(TOT_VIAG ~ Treated * Year_Factor * factor(Strata) 
                      + sexo_harm + educ_harm + activity_harm + has_car 
                      + age_group, data = master_matched_mah, weights = FE_PESS)
res_ddd_int_mah <- coeftest(mod_ddd_int_mah, vcov = vcovCL(mod_ddd_int_mah, cluster = ~ZONA_07))

# Logit
mod_ddd_int_log <- lm(TOT_VIAG ~ Treated * Year_Factor * factor(Strata)
                      + sexo_harm + educ_harm + activity_harm + has_car 
                      + age_group, data = master_matched_log, weights = FE_PESS)
res_ddd_int_log <- coeftest(mod_ddd_int_log, vcov = vcovCL(mod_ddd_int_log, cluster = ~ZONA_07))

# --- EXPORT ARTIFACTS ---
saveRDS(master_sample_table, here("data", "processed", "02_master_sample_table-9s.rds"))
saveRDS(list(mah = master_matched_mah, log = master_matched_log), here("data", "processed", "02_master_matched_data-9s.rds"))
saveRDS(experiments, here("data", "processed", "02_experiments_results-9s.rds"))
saveRDS(list(mah = res_ddd_int_mah, log = res_ddd_int_log), here("data", "processed", "02_triple_diff_results-9s.rds"))
```


```{r contraexperimento-did}
#| label: contraexperimento did
#| cache: true
#| eval: false

panel_base <- readRDS(here("data", "processed", "01_panel_base_clean.rds"))


# 1. Prepare the CS-DiD variables
did_df_cs <- panel_base %>%
  mutate(
    ID_PESS = as.numeric(ID_PESS),
    Y_Binary = ifelse(TOT_VIAG > 0, 1, 0),
    # Create the Group variable: 2018 for treated zones, 0 for control zones
    first_treat_year = ifelse(Treated == 1, 2018, 0),
  )

# 2. Run the CS-DiD Estimator
did_contra <- att_gt(
  yname = "TOT_VIAG", # Swap to "TOT_VIAG" to test the Intensive Margin
  tname =  "Year",
  #idname = "ID_PESS", 
  gname = "first_treat_year", 
  xformla = ~ 1,
  data = did_df_cs,
  panel = FALSE, # CRITICAL: Tells the package this is a repeated cross-section
  allow_unbalanced_panel = TRUE, 
  weightsname = "FE_PESS",
  control_group = "nevertreated", # Explicitly defines the 0 group as the control
  bstrap = TRUE, # Enables wild bootstrap for robust standard errors
  cband = TRUE   # Computes simultaneous confidence bands
)

# 3. View the baseline Group-Time Average Treatment Effects
summary(did_contra)

# 4. Aggregate into an Event Study (Dynamic Effects)
es_contra <- aggte(did_contra, type = "dynamic")
summary(es_contra)
ggdid(did_contra)
ggdid(es_contra)
```
